details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: path traversal when creating intermediate directories
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53785.patch: add do_mkdir_at() in syscall.c and
       route make_path() through it, so each missing directory is created
       relative to a parent walked one component at a time with O_NOFOLLOW
       instead of a plain mkdir() on the full path
     - CVE-2026-53785
